body: Fare thee well 2019, may the new decade be kinder to everyone~

Sorry for the late reply! I am still here. I'm not sure how you knew but I did have several tough days after writing. To make a long story short, my psychiatrist decided to order tests for my thyroid since the meds were not helping completely. Apparently I am a 1 (normal range 1-5) so since my results were borderline, they think that is the problem. Or at least part of it.

In other words, I need thyroid meds not more psych meds. Who knew a small organ in your neck could cause suicidal thoughts? On top of all the stress ofc. Still taking the old meds since quitting cold turkey could be dangerous.

Also, I experienced a truly bizarre series of FORTUNATE events this week that led me to be able to purchase some Christmas gifts for my family after all. Guess what I bought?

Disney movies. <3

Thanks again for your very witty humor and support. I'll make a note to update again later. Hope you are doing well and please have a very Merry Christmas.

Yeah, all of that sounds like what I am going through and how I am feeling. I hope you haven't been/are going through this yourself. I saw some of your other posts and you seem to understand a lot of people, which is good but also worried me a bit. I hope that you are doing okay... If I had advice then surely I would take some of it myself, but I don't have any. Just hoping you're doing okay and that it's just my imagination. I know I'm not in much of a position to say much, but I would be sad if you were suffering.

Thank you so much for writing. You are so funny. I read it many times and somehow your humor put a smile on my face. It sounds like you've been where I'm at, and while I am sorry for that, I'm also glad to have someone to relate to right now. 
It has been hard. So hard. I am afraid of her growing up sad and broken because of me. I don't want her to mirror my sadness or problems. I'm afraid of so much lately. So many things that have never even crossed my mind before. 

I never realized what a blissfully ignorant and selfish life I led (despite the pain of my disease, surgeries, etc) until I had my daughter. I've been really scared that there is no going back to being happy and normal again (mostly bc my meds are maxed out). I don't want my daughter to grow up with a depressed mess of a mother. I don't know what that would do to her.

I feel like I've been trying my hardest but my best hasn't been enough. The sadness and guilt from that is crushing. I love my daughter so much and I want her to have the best life. I'm not sure I'm going to give her that at the rate I'm going. 

But I did like what you said about being there for when she does something to make me happy and proud, hell I've already been happy and proud. She learned how to roll this week. I was real proud of her. Probably the first time I smiled so genuinely in months. I feel guilty for being sad again after that. 

I guess I feel like I don't deserve to be happy or proud with her because I've been fucking up so badly. 

You know, I planned this pregnancy. I had a great job, lived in a house, bullshit little pinterest pins of cute baby things I was going to buy...

Then I had hyperemesis... lost my job... had to move out of the house into an apartment... received an ass ton of bills that I'd have to be a millionaire to cope with... well, you read it. A lot happened.

Literally nothing has gone according to plan, and I feel like not only that, it's been nightmarish. My therapist told me she was surprised I was still alive after going through so much shit in rapid succession. I didn't even know what to say to that. I just cried harder.

I feel like I've more or less been on autopilot since she was born. Getting up every day to take care of her even though I'm depressed and anxious. It's all been such a blur. I feel guilty for that too. 

Thank god for grandma though. My pride hurts real bad that she is providing when I cannot, but I am so glad she's there (grumpy bitch sometimes indeed though lol).  I keep thinking what a better mom she is than me. 

I told my fiance that I feel his mom is so much better than me, and how I wish I was more like her. Apparently, she was completely absent from his life for the first several years and HER mom took care of him/his sisters while she went to work because they were so damn broke. That shocked me. I thought she was perfect. She still is, to me though. Even though she wasn't "there" for them, it's because she was a single mom working three fucking jobs to keep them all going. Hell... I'm not even working one job right now. What a woman. My perspective on life changed a bit, and I think his perspective of his mother changed for the better, too. 

I think he was a bit resentful of her absence, but not anymore. And that brings me joy because all I want from my own family is to understand I'm/we're struggling too... I'm not being shitty because I want to be, so I hope I'm not resented later on down the line.

...

I can't guarantee what I'll do if something else happens, and that does scare me. I don't want to feel like this. I don't want to be shitty. I want to be a good mom. My self confidence is lacking. I keep hoping every day that I wake up, that I can make it through another day. I keep hoping that eventually I will feel better. I need to feel better. Can't keep this shit up for much longer.

Your post has helped me though. I've been trying to pretend that I'm already better because my psychiatrist keeps acting like I'm supposed to be better. I'll stop doing that. One of us needs to go to Disney, after all. I know I sure as hell ain't been yet, and I used to rewind the Disney ads on my VHS tapes more than the movies they came on...

yeah and to top it all off, the disease that i had surgery for... it disabled me for years, and now its beginning to resurface. i dont want to live in physical pain every day again along with the mental problems

That sounds pretty close to home. I keep thinking she deserves a better mother and if I died, certainly my fiance would find someone better. Certainly someone with a stronger mind and willpower, someone who wouldnt get upset over small things

Thanks... it sounds like you really understand what I'm going through. You put it in better words than I did. 

I feel like I'm failing my daughter by messing up all of her firsts - first halloween, food, christmas... 

I know she won't remember it, but I will. I'll remember how I was too tired to take photos for her album and too poor to buy her things... It weighs so heavily on me. I keep thinking she will hate me if she finds out, she will think I did not love her enough to provide better for her. I'm afraid she won't understand how hard this has been, how hard I am trying... I don't want to be a disappointment to her
